items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: we had the violinist from France was the guest for Benny... I stayed there and made his rehearsal with him and everything and I caught his group

ctx.x: I'm not taking the knowledge -- I'm not trying to take his knowledge or anything. But to me, I don't think public-wise people want to know about knowledge. I think they want to feel you more. This is just a personal feeling. I don't -- you know, I'm not saying anything's wrong -- and so his earlier things impress me more than the later ones because -- and I know Sonny can play. And he played up in -- he played with us. He followed Benny and it must have been about June the 24th, we played at Carnegie, because we…

Uh-huh. Then Marion followed, then Sonny followed it later, different crowd, you know, turned everybody out and he had a good crowd. He asked me to stay to listen to his band, you know, listen to his band. You know what makes me feel good about things like that? He always comes up and say, "Man, I used to listen to Prez and you, man, I used to -- and man, you did a lot. You've influenced me, although I'm playing a different thing," he said, "but I remember how you all used to sound." Well, that's a good feeling,…
